note: Developer helper submodule for Content Sync: version-mismatch warnings plus Drush commands (csuf, csfed). Its only persistent state is the cms_content_sync.developer config key version_mismatch (a map keyed by flow id), which is safe to read/write via the config factory without any sync backend. Medium reads that config; hard writes it.

evals.prompt: In the cms_content_sync_developer module, which Drush command re-exports/updates all Content Sync flow configurations (and clears version warnings), and what is its alias?
The cms_content_sync_developer module adds a Drush command to force-delete an entity from Content Sync's bookkeeping. What is the command (or alias) and which options select the entity?
evals.expected_output: cms_content_sync_developer:force-entity-deletion (alias csfed); selects the entity with --entity_uuid=<uuid> or --bundle=<bundle> on a given entity type, e.g. drush csfed node --entity_uuid=...

evals.prompt: The cms_content_sync_developer module warns site builders about out-of-date flows. Which config object and key hold that version-mismatch state, and how is it kept out of exported configuration?
evals.expected_output: State lives in the cms_content_sync.developer config under the key version_mismatch (a map keyed by flow id). hook_config_ignore_settings_alter() adds cms_content_sync.developer:version_mismatch to config_ignore so it is not exported.

evals.prompt: On this site, the cms_content_sync_developer module currently records a version mismatch for exactly one flow. Inspect the live cms_content_sync.developer configuration and give the machine id of the flow that is flagged.
evals.expected_output: The flow ccs_known_flow is flagged: cms_content_sync.developer:version_mismatch contains the key ccs_known_flow. Read with drush cget cms_content_sync.developer version_mismatch.

evals.prompt: On this site, use the cms_content_sync_developer state configuration to flag the flow with machine id 'ccs_task_flow' as having a version mismatch. That is, add ccs_task_flow as a key under version_mismatch in the cms_content_sync.developer config and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: cms_content_sync.developer:version_mismatch is a map containing the key ccs_task_flow, e.g. \Drupal::configFactory()->getEditable('cms_content_sync.developer')->set('version_mismatch', ['ccs_task_flow' => ['name' => 'CCS Task Flow']])->save();
